title: Ethereal Light Swirls
description: An abstract painting featuring flowing, sweeping brushstrokes in pastel hues that curve dynamically across the canvas. Delicate splatters, dots, and fine lines of white, gold, and iridescent pigment create a sense of luminous movement against soft white and lavender backgrounds.
prompt: abstract painting with dynamic flowing brushstrokes in soft pastel colors, sweeping curves of pale yellow, lavender, and turquoise blending into white, accented with delicate splatters, fine gold and white lines, and scattered luminous dots, creating a sense of ethereal movement and light, soft blended textures with visible brushwork
